newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of imports.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee untraded on lack of imports.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee was unmoved against the dollar in early Thursday trade due to low commercial demand and a high supply of the greenback, dealers said.
At 0500 GMT the rupee was quoted at its opening level of 58.48 to the dollar.
"There is hardly any demand for spot. Only a few forward trades have been done since morning," said a foreign bank dealer.
The Central Bank left the dollar-rupee exchange rate unchanged and buying and selling prices were at 58.4843 and 59.6658.
Overnight call money rates were at 9.5 percent after opening at 9.375, despite a big state bank borrowing, dealers said.
